title: Coefficients after Fourier substitution
statement: For any $n\ge 0$ and any function $p:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the numerical coefficient function of $x\mapsto p(\operatorname{sign}(x))$ is the coefficient function $c$ given, for each coordinate subset $T$, by $\displaystyle c(T)=(-2)^{|T|}\sum_{S\supseteq T}\widehat p(S)$, where $\widehat p(S)$ is the uniform Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$.
